Abdullah ibn Muhammad Abdullah ibn Muhammad also known as Tahir ibn Muhammad(" Tahirclean/ pure") or Tayib ibn Muhammad was one of the sons of Muhammad and Khadija. Qasim ibn Muhammad was his older brother. Muhammad gave him the name of his father. Abdullah died in childhood in 615 CE.
